title: FillblocksClientSDK
tagline: FillBlocks Plug n Play SDK syncs Web2 education data with Web3 turning into verifiable lifelong data
description:
Education still runs on Web2 infrastructure. Schools and universities manage critical records like certificates, student reports, and other important data in centralized databases that are vulnerable to tampering, accidental loss, or even insider manipulation. Verification is slow, costly, and often unreliable.

FillBlocks solves this by acting as a bridge between Web2 and Web3 systems. With just one integration, institutions can sync their existing databases onchain, ensuring that every academic record is stored permanently and immutably. At the same time, GraphQL queries provides fast, real-time querying, so performance feels like Web2 but with the trust guarantees of Web3.
Students benefit by owning academic records that cannot be forged or lost. Institutions save time and resources by reducing manual verification and preventing fraud. Employers and universities gain instant trust when reviewing credentials.
With FillBlocks, education records become lifelong, tamper-proof digital assets
how_its_made:
FillBlocks System Architecture and Implementation

Data Flow Pipeline:
Educational Data → MongoDB → SDK Processing → Hash Generation → Arweave Storage → Flow Blockchain
Mongoose Models → Data Sync on Arweave → SHA-256 → Flow Smart Contracts → Immutable Record → Global Access

Why Flow Blockchain:
- High Performance: 1000+ TPS with low latency
- Resource-Oriented: EVM support for secure contracts
- Multi-Role Architecture: Specialized nodes for different functions
- Developer-Friendly: Easy integration with existing systems
- Scalability: Built for mainstream adoption
 
Smart Contract Features:
- Credential Storage: Immutable academic records
- Academic Snapshot Compatibility: Snapshot/Group certain records in one
- Access Control: Role-based permissions
- Global Standards: Universal credential format for learners
